class.name: FactionRegistry
class.brief_description: Registry for all factions in the simulation.
class.description: Manages faction instances, provides relationship queries (allies/enemies), and updates faction alertness/strength based on agent casualties.

method.name: add_faction
method.description: Registers a faction in the registry.

method.name: get_faction
method.description: Returns the faction with the given ID, or null if not found.

method.name: get_faction_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered factions.

method.name: are_enemies
method.description: Returns true if faction A considers faction B an enemy.

method.name: are_allies
method.description: Returns true if faction A considers faction B an ally.
